settings.ggE07h9LQ2g_text: Why your dog needs dental care?
settings.ggSqV_gqapF_text:
Did you know that 80% of all dogs develop gum problems by the age of 3?

When bacteria build up along the gumline, they can spread through the bloodstream and damage vital organs such as the heart, liver, and kidneys – in the worst cases, this can shorten your dog’s life by several years.

 

This is especially common among small dog breeds, which are at higher risk of dental problems early in life.
